context: Hiroshi-boss and Ren review a staffing survey.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: business HR; vocabulary (人事/学部/アンケート/載っ/語っ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人事のアンケートは、まとまったかね?
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、結果が資料に載っています。
lines.en: Yes, the results are in the document.
lines.style: reliable young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 若手は、どんな学部の出身かね?
lines.en: What faculties are the young staff from?
lines.style: thoughtful boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 技術系の学部が、多いです。
lines.style: precise young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: アンケートで、何か語っていたかね?
lines.en: Did they say anything in the survey?
lines.style: engaged boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 多くが、成長したいと語っていました。
lines.en: Many said they want to grow.
lines.style: measured young presenter voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 人事の方針に、載せておこう。
lines.en: Let's put it in the HR policy.
lines.style: decisive boss voice, soft warm inquiry throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 社員の声を、しっかり載せます。
lines.en: I'll firmly include the employees' voices.
lines.style: resolved young presenter voice, soft warm closing throughout
